main.description: Upgrade one of the caller's instances to the newer HappyView release its availableVersion offers, and start a job that follows the upgrade. The instance is offline for about 30 seconds; its database is snapshotted first, and a release that does not come up healthy is rolled back. Customers only.

version.description: The release to upgrade to: the instance's availableVersion.version, as the caller was shown it.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per intended change and resends on every retry of it, so a retry gets the original reply instead of acting twice.

jobId.description: The background job following the change. Poll it with at.happyproto.server.getJob.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: id or idempotencyKey is missing or not a UUID, version is missing, or the release is not newer than the one the instance runs.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance, or it is not the caller's. The two are indistinguishable.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: it reserves slugs by configuration as well.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance is already changing, or a request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: UpgradeUnavailable
errors.description: The release is not the one on offer for this instance: there is none, a newer one replaced it, or the instance already runs it.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers, or the job could not be started.
